proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5430 article gives Malayalam vīr̤uka to fall, fall off, be passed (as urine), perish; vīr̤ikka to cause to fall; vīr̤ttuka id., make water; vīr̤kka to put off clothes; vir̤ukka to fell, put off as clothes; vir̤ca fall, failure, ruin; vīr̤pu filthy clothes (esp. menstruous).. The Malayalam survey form vīɻ “fall” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
